name: United States (federal)
disclaimer: General information about US federal law to help you organise your record. It is not legal advice and may not apply to your situation. State and local laws may also apply, sometimes with different time limits.

statutes.name: Civil Rights Act of 1964, Title VII
statutes.summary: Protects against discrimination and harassment because of race, colour, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation and gender identity) or national origin, and against retaliation for complaining. Applies to employers with 15 or more employees.

limitation.label: File a charge with the EEOC
limitation.note: Usually 180 days from the incident, or 300 days where a state or local agency also enforces a similar law. For ongoing harassment the period can run from the most recent incident.

statutes.name: Americans with Disabilities Act
statutes.summary: Protects people with disabilities from discrimination and harassment, and requires reasonable accommodations unless they cause undue hardship. Applies to employers with 15 or more employees.

limitation.label: File a charge with the EEOC
limitation.note: Usually 180 days from the incident, or 300 days where a state or local agency also enforces a similar law. For ongoing harassment the period can run from the most recent incident.

statutes.name: Age Discrimination in Employment Act
statutes.summary: Protects people aged 40 and over from age discrimination and harassment. Applies to employers with 20 or more employees.

limitation.label: File a charge with the EEOC
limitation.note: Usually 180 days from the incident, or 300 days where a state or local agency also enforces a similar law. For ongoing harassment the period can run from the most recent incident.

statutes.name: Family and Medical Leave Act
statutes.summary: Gives eligible employees up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave for serious health conditions, a new child or caring for family, and protects against interference or retaliation.

agency.name: US Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division

limitation.label: Bring an FMLA claim
limitation.note: Generally two years from the last violation, or three years if it was wilful.

statutes.name: Fair Labor Standards Act
statutes.summary: Sets the federal minimum wage, overtime pay and record-keeping rules, and protects employees who complain about pay from retaliation.

agency.name: US Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division

limitation.label: Bring a wage claim
limitation.note: Generally two years from each underpayment, or three years if it was wilful.

statutes.name: Occupational Safety and Health Act
statutes.summary: Requires a workplace free from serious recognised hazards, and protects employees who raise safety concerns from retaliation.

limitation.label: Report safety retaliation to OSHA
limitation.note: Retaliation for raising a safety concern must usually be reported within 30 days. Other whistleblower laws enforced by OSHA allow longer.

statutes.name: Equal Pay Act
statutes.summary: Requires equal pay for men and women doing substantially equal work in the same workplace.

limitation.label: Bring an Equal Pay Act claim
limitation.note: Generally two years from the unequal paycheque, or three years if wilful. No EEOC charge is needed first, though Title VII claims about pay do need one.

statutes.name: Genetic Information Nondiscrimination Act
statutes.summary: Prohibits using genetic information, including family medical history, in employment decisions.

limitation.label: File a charge with the EEOC
limitation.note: Usually 180 days from the incident, or 300 days where a state or local agency also enforces a similar law. For ongoing harassment the period can run from the most recent incident.

statutes.name: Education Amendments of 1972, Title IX
statutes.summary: Prohibits sex discrimination, including sexual harassment, in education programmes that receive federal funding, including for employees of schools and universities.

agency.name: US Department of Education, Office for Civil Rights

limitation.label: File a complaint with the Office for Civil Rights
limitation.note: Usually within 180 days of the incident.

support.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
support.description: Free, confidential support any time. Call or text 988.

support.name: NAMI HelpLine
support.description: Information and support for mental health, weekdays.
